title: The Secret Dinner
staging:
Scene 14 — The Secret Dinner

12:35–13:35 · 60 sec · Steak & Bone private dining room

Barkington meets the Shiba Inu WOOF7 news anchor. The two discuss public confidence, news coverage, and the shortage. Barkington speaks indirectly, never openly admitting to controlling the salmon supply.

Shots: Dining-room wide → two-shot across table → close-up of Shiba anchor → Barkington's gold ring and paw → hidden surveillance angle.

lines.speaker: Barkington
lines.text: The public needs reassurance that our supply measures are necessary.
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: And you want that to be tonight's headline?
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: People are asking why the shelves emptied before the warning. They expect me to ask that question.
lines.origin: new production draft v003; not yet recorded
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Barkington
lines.text: Questions are useful when they lead the public toward confidence. Less useful when they lead to disorder.
lines.origin: new production draft v003; not yet recorded
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Barkington
lines.text: I want the public to hear the correct story.
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Confidence is difficult to sell to an audience that cannot afford dinner.
lines.origin: new production draft v003; not yet recorded
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: That kind of coverage isn't cheap.
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Barkington
lines.text: Then remind them who keeps the streets safe. Panic needs a firm voice.
lines.origin: new production draft v003; not yet recorded
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: My producers will want a reason to move the other story off the schedule.
lines.origin: new production draft v003; not yet recorded
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Barkington
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Barkington
lines.text: Tell them we appreciate a reliable partner. Our appreciation is rarely symbolic.
